# Comment pointers still to be rewritten in _test.go files, per file.
#
# The SECOND of two budgets. The production budget (comment_budget.txt) is
# finished and empty; this one is not, and the two fall independently.
#
# WHY THIS SCOPE EXISTS. Test comments were deliberately excluded from the
# production migration, on the reviewer's condition that the exclusion be
# TRACKED rather than dropped. A note would have aged; this is a ratchet.
#
# A pointer in a test is not automatically the same defect as one in production
# code, and saying so is the argument for migrating them. A comment reading
# "criterion 9" or "ADR-0013 section 3.1" is trying to say WHICH REQUIREMENT
# the test pins -- real information, in a form the reader cannot resolve. The
# migration keeps the information and drops the coordinate: state the
# requirement, so the test says what it defends rather than naming the document
# that defends it.
#
# These numbers MAY ONLY FALL. Delete a line when its file reaches zero; a file
# that is not listed here is frozen at zero and cannot regain one. The budget is
# EXACT, not a ceiling, so an improvement must be recorded in the same change or
# it can be silently undone later. The destination is an empty file.
#
# The total is NOT stored here -- it is derived from the lines below and printed
# by the test, which is the single place it is computed.
#
# ONE FILE IS EXEMPT BY NAME, not by shape: internal/audit/comment_budget_test.go,
# whose pointer "hits" are the shapes the detectors match, quoted in prose to
# document what each one catches. The reason, the premise it rests on and a
# liveness check all live with the guard -- see selfDocumenting there.
